items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We used to see Art there all the time, with Javon.

ctx.x: Then it moved – I’m trying to think – it moved someplace down a little further around a little corner there somewhere.
We used to see Art there all the time, with Javon. That was when Javon was a kid, 19 maybe or – Jazz Messengers. New York, New York. There’s no place like it.
Talk about a slew of trios that you’ve been involved with. Some of them we don’t know about, like Warren Bernhardt, Dave Holland.
